correction: Appended an explanatory four-cell checkerboard illustration and precise accompanying Remarks only. Original title, frontmatter, statement, Facts, and all counterexample steps remain byte-identical.

diagram_math_checks.result: Lower-left and upper-right cells are q=+1; upper-left and lower-right cells are q=-1, exactly as step 1.1. Each cell is one quarter of the unit square, so the mean is (1-1-1+1)/4=0.

The mesh has 3x3=9 nodes: eight boundary nodes shown open and the sole interior center shown filled. Given zero boundary values fixes both velocity components at all eight open nodes. Step 1.1 gives phi=eta(x)eta(y), with phi(center)=1; the scalar space has one free coefficient, and step 3.1 gives two vector coefficients a,b.
Drawing coordinates 0,2,4 correspond affinely to unit-square coordinates 0,1/2,1. Straight horizontal and vertical dividers produce exactly four equal squares; x increases rightward and y upward.

For the x derivative, lower-left/lower-right contributions are +1/4,+1/4 and upper-left/upper-right contributions are -1/4,-1/4, summing to zero by the eta integrals in step 2.1. For the y derivative the lower-left/upper-left contributions are +1/4,+1/4 and lower-right/upper-right contributions are -1/4,-1/4. Thus both asserted integrals vanish, and step 3.1 gives b((a phi,b phi),q)=0.
